question: In which of the following years was the first thermal power plant of the Calcutta Electric Supply Corporation Limited commissioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1899**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Calcutta Electric Supply Corporation Limited (CESC)** commissioned its first **thermal power plant** in the year **1899**.
 
• The plant was established in Kolkata (then Calcutta), which was among the first cities in India to have access to electricity.
 
• This development marked a significant milestone in the history of electricity generation in India. *Hence, the correct year is **1899**.*
 
• The commissioning of this thermal power plant was instrumental in providing electricity to urban areas of Calcutta and later expanded to surrounding regions.
